title: Remove linked ticket
purpose: Remove a ticket from a nonconformance's linked tickets, with a reason.
summary: Remove a ticket from a nonconformance's linked tickets, with a reason. The link stays in the history. The owner or a supervisor does this.

tasks.title: Remove a linked ticket
steps: Under Linked tickets on the record select [[Remove]] beside the ticket.
Check the [[Ticket]] and [[Subject]] shown, explain in [[Reason]] and select [[Remove ticket]].

tasks.title: Link it again later
steps: On the record select [[Add ticket]] and type its number.

good_to_know: The complaint the record was opened from stays linked and has no Remove button.
The link stays in the history with your reason.
The ticket's timeline records that it is no longer linked to the nonconformance.
If the link was removed meanwhile or you can no longer open the ticket, saving is refused: This ticket is no longer linked or no longer open to you.

sections.title: Access
paragraphs: Opens from Remove beside a linked ticket on the record, as a dialog or a full page. Only the owner or a supervisor (the admin role included) may open it, and only for a current link to a ticket you may open now; otherwise it answers Not found or is refused. While the optional nonconformance module is off it answers Not found.

items.label: Ticket, Subject
items.description: The linked ticket you are removing.

items.label: Reason
items.description: Required, up to 4,000 characters. Kept with the removal in the record's history.

items.label: Remove ticket
items.description: Removes the ticket from Linked tickets and confirms Linked ticket removed. The record's history records Linked ticket removed with your reason; the ticket's timeline records No longer linked to nonconformance NC-000123. The link itself is kept with who removed it and when.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Returns to the record and keeps the link.

items.label: Complaint it was opened from
items.description: That ticket stays linked: The complaint it was opened from stays linked.

items.label: Versions
items.description: Removing advances the version of the record and of the ticket. If the record changed after you opened this form: This nonconformance changed after you opened it. Reload it and review the latest details.

items.label: Closed record
items.description: A closed nonconformance does not change. A supervisor can reopen it.
